observations.observation: South Sydney has confirmed Euan Aitken will miss the rest of the season with a fractured scapula. Tallis Duncan is expected to return after being rested in Round 27.
observations.decision_effect: Mixed Rabbitohs continuity effect: Aitken loss is negative, Duncan return offsets some forward disruption.
observations.tip_effect: Rabbitohs retained at 69%; no unsupported confidence movement before official team-list reconciliation.

observations.observation: Phoenix Crossland has publicly stated he will play after minor surgery. Francis Manuleleua remains in rehabilitation after a dislocated elbow and is not yet confirmed for Week 1.
observations.decision_effect: Positive Newcastle spine/rotation continuity signal; strengthens the adversarial case against South Sydney.
observations.tip_effect: Rabbitohs retained at 69%; decision remains CURRENT_NOT_FROZEN.

observations.player: Jackson Ford / Leka Halasima / Dallin Watene-Zelezniak
observations.observation: Jackson Ford and Leka Halasima are expected back for the qualifying final. Dallin Watene-Zelezniak is an outside chance and remains unresolved pending fitness and official selection.
observations.decision_effect: Positive Warriors middle/edge continuity signal, with residual outside-back uncertainty.

observations.observation: Current reporting expects Selwyn Cobbo and Kodi Nikorima to return to the starting side after missing or being managed in Round 27.
observations.decision_effect: Positive Dolphins counter-case; reduces the informational value of their Round 27 configuration as a full-strength baseline.

observations.observation: Current reporting expects Braydon Trindall to return if he gets through training. Official NRL judiciary reporting lists Michael Gabrael with a Grade 3 Careless High Tackle charge, plea TBC, carrying 2-3 matches; no final suspension outcome is treated as verified yet.
observations.decision_effect: Potentially material positive Sharks spine continuity from Trindall, offset by unresolved centre-depth risk through Gabrael.
observations.tip_effect: Sharks retained at 64%; no uplift before Trindall and Gabrael states are formally resolved.

observations.observation: Official NRL judiciary reporting at 2:19pm AEST confirms Reuben Cotter pleaded not guilty to the Grade 2 Careless High Tackle charge and will front the judiciary on Tuesday night. A not-guilty finding makes him available for the Sharks elimination final; a guilty finding results in a two-match suspension.
observations.decision_effect: Material Cowboys middle-continuity uncertainty remains active until the judiciary outcome is verified.

observations.player: Isaah Yeo / Mitch Kenny / Scott Sorensen
observations.observation: Isaah Yeo and Mitch Kenny completed successful Round 27 returns; Scott Sorensen is expected back for Week 1 pending official selection.

observations.player: James Tedesco / Daly Cherry-Evans / Victor Radley / Angus Crichton / senior cohort
observations.observation: The Roosters are set to restore a large senior cohort rested in Round 27, including James Tedesco, Daly Cherry-Evans and Victor Radley. Angus Crichton remains reported as a selection possibility rather than verified. Sam Walker remains unlikely before a potential preliminary final.
observations.decision_effect: Strong Roosters counter-case; confirms Round 27 should remain heavily down-weighted as a finals-strength indicator.
observations.tip_effect: Panthers retained at 73%; no confidence chase.
